The math

Banyan pays for itself in 5 nights.

A family that stays just twice a year (Diwali + summer) saves more on rooms alone than the membership costs. Add in 2 free nights, a free Do Dham yatra, and unlimited yoga, and you're looking at ₹60,000+ of value for a ₹14,999 fee.
